summary: Lego Star Wars entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Lego Star Wars: The Video Game
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows PC release for exact route; The Complete Saga labeled separately if used

emulation.notes: Native PC route preferred for original capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original PC release with documented compatibility setup

primary.version: Original PC release, with The Complete Saga documented separately
primary.why: The original 2005 game is distinct from later compilations and remakes. The Complete Saga is a more accessible modern collection route, but exact archive coverage of this entry should label whether it is the original PC/console release or the later compilation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the original PC release for the exact 2005 route. Record version, compatibility fixes, controller, episode/chapter, extras/unlocks, co-op state, and whether The Complete Saga was used only as a comparative collection route.

secondary.platform: Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga
secondary.exclusive_content: Compilation of the first two Lego Star Wars games with changes and additional content
secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting the compilation route separately.
secondary.why: It is not the untouched 2005 release.

secondary.platform: PlayStation 2 / GameCube / Xbox / Game Boy Advance
secondary.why: PC is the best capture route for the original.

all_releases.fidelity: Original release family, with PC preferred for capture.

all_releases.platform: Lego Star Wars: The Complete Saga
all_releases.reason: secondary: accessible collection, but distinct from the original game.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Complete Saga is more accessible, but it is a compilation route rather than the exact 2005 game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not substitute The Skywalker Saga for this entry.
